status: conditional finite readiness cost; no live maxima as inputs; does not amend trigger/cap/paired workload

conditional_serialized_message_envelope.premise: The1024B per-entry envelope must be independently justified/enforced for actual metadata. It is a design budget, not an observed35-byte header. BK journal/entrylog/control records are additional history.

nominal_no_early_rollover_case.extra_premise: No early age/error/recovery close while publishing; this is not implied by maxEntries5 or the300s producer timeout.

no_minimum_fill_case.basis: Each nonempty data ledger holds at least one of the11 unique admitted entries; failures/retries/duplicate successful writes require their separate budget.

creation_history_rule: ledgerClosed calls createLedgerAfterClosed; a partial tail can age-roll and allocate an empty successor. Reserve at least one empty successor beyond nonempty ledgers, and separately bound failed/reopened generations. Empty successors do not produce offload pairs but do create BK/ZK metadata and controls.
required_binding: Actual automatic offload and independently observed BK deletion, not HTTP readiness alone; use at least one data ledger, not a demanded arbitrary count of all three.
Retain readiness-topic initial/continuous/final and completion trace, including publication interval and source key/count/extent join.

Bind the same broker pod UID/container ID/restartCount and unchanged namespace policy to the following positive stream; shared namespace1 bundle explains the intended owner equality but does not waive handoff checks.
Charge one extra topic MLInfo and namespace-dedup pulsar.dedup cursor plus its data/cursor ledger metadata and session/watch/history effects.
The100×4096 positive/control payload/rate,32768 trigger and65536 hot cap remain the same.
An unload/read probe adds a real subscription cursor and can reopen/create more data/cursor ledgers; broker/gateway restarts add sessions/registration/history and retain old physical budgets.
unsupported_conclusions: ceil(11/5)=3 is not an unconditional maximum ledger count.
An11-message cap proof does not derive from a live hot maximum or assume35 bytes metadata/entry.
6MiB or22MiB is an allocation within the existing shared128-pair population, not a new uncharged pool.
A current complete observed history within4MiB does not itself derive a pre-run bound on all control/retry/erased history.
